{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":900,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax));","note":"The input is treated as a regex pattern and compiled by Oniguruma through mbstring."},
{"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5441,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"Compilation reaches quantifier tuning, which recursively inspects the quantified body for empty-repeat and memory-node state."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the vulnerable analysis path implicated by the crash report's state."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4904,"var":"NODE_CAR(node)","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(NODE_CAR(node));","note":"Nested list/alt nodes are traversed recursively, allowing crafted patterns to drive the problematic state propagation."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5629,"var":"r","code":"r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The compiler continues tuning after the recursive analysis, using the derived state to update regex metadata."},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The compiled regex is then executed against the subject string, reaching the same vulnerable Oniguruma state during matching."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('updated')
